description:
Exclusive candidate scope: benchbox/platforms/dataframe/unified_frame.py private deferred-filter boundary and precisely assigned typing/AST tests, before expression cleanup; matching tests/generators/outputs/reference pages only as frozen by scope-policy. Exclude other task manifests, shared integrator files, upstream/external mirrors and historical evidence. Unknown ownership/consumer blocks deletion; never expand a worker scope unilaterally.

Target: zero discretionary explanatory comments and authored explanatory docstrings in maintained first-party code. Only proven minimum machine directives and unavoidable provenance-bound required notices remain. Useful product strings must have an actual consumer; no inert constants, unused strings, fake metadata or dynamic __doc__ replacements. Never broaden lint/type/coverage ignores, weaken assertions, or turn unknown ownership/parser coverage into an exclusion.

Required work and decisions: Assess existing TYPE_CHECKING DataFusionExpr type and sibling implementation. Narrow Any only if actual dispatch permits it; otherwise record a demonstrated constraint without explanatory source text. Preserve deferred .filter(...).build(), lazy SDK imports and actual aggregate callable behavior. No blind casts, broad ignores, invented wrappers or direct eager evaluation. This is a separate typing/simplification slice, not AST-equivalent deletion.

Trace substantive explanation to requirement, callers, actual behavior and existing tests. Delete filler/false claims; move necessary contracts/rationale to owning external references or actually consumed metadata before deleting source text. Evaluate the smallest adequate mechanism; executable simplification/type/behavior changes require separate approval and reviewed slices, with no new abstraction solely to house prose. Preserve runtime/output consumers before removal.

Deliver source-only deletion and, where relevant, later dedicated SQL/output payload batches with explicit identity/correctness evidence. One ownership task may need multiple pilot-budget-approved PRs. Shared documentation must be published by its owner before affected deletion. Execution guard: creation of this TODO is planning, not approval to execute the reviewed cleanup. Obtain later implementation authorization. Use a separate linked worktree and agent-write-preflight; preserve unrelated work. Freeze nonoverlapping code/test/doc paths with the integrator before dispatch. Ordinary independent PRs target develop; serialize shared test-lock checks and integration, not module edits. Required native/external soundness review remains mandatory, with no auto-merge bypass. No live cloud/stress, deployment, publication, historical-result rewriting, or unapproved external-repository writes.
